name: Canary
source:
https://cryptlark.itch.io/canary

A marriage promised. Doors slammed shut on an eight-bedroom estate and an entire dowry. A collar at her throat. A cage in a whorehouse. Chantal wants out, and the gilded sun mages don’t care. Their precious Canary is dead. And now there’s a half-dead stranger on her floor.
translation:
https://cryptlark.itch.io/canary

曾经许下的婚约化为泡影。拥有八间卧室的庄园与整份嫁妆对她紧闭大门。颈间套着项圈，困于妓院的囚笼。尚塔尔一心想要逃离，可那些高高在上的鎏金日耀法师根本不在乎——他们珍爱的“金丝雀”早已死去。而此刻，她的地板上正躺着一个奄奄一息的陌生人。
